title: Measurement
description: One brightness measurement of a source, as a magnitude, a flux density or a band-integrated flux, carrying the epoch, instrument and calibration that belong to it rather than to the notice. A notice reporting a table of measurements, as a circular does, holds an array of these; Spectral and Photometry describe the single measurement case. Units are those of Spectral, referenced rather than restated.

time.description: Mid-exposure epoch of this measurement [ISO 8601, UTC].

telescope.description: Telescope that made this measurement (e.g., GTC, ZTF, VLA).

instrument.description: Instrument used, where it is distinguished from the telescope (e.g., OSIRIS, EP-FXT).

filter.description: Filter as named by the observer (e.g., u, g, r, Rc, F160W, clear).

filter_id.description: Canonical identifier for the filter, preferably an SVO Filter Profile Service id (e.g., SLOAN/SDSS.r).

spectral_point.description: Frequency, wavelength or energy at which the measurement was made.

spectral_band.description: Low and high bounds of the band the value is integrated over.

value.description: Measured value where is_detection is true, upper limit where it is false.

value_error.description: 1-sigma statistical uncertainty on value, in the same unit.

is_detection.description: True where value is a measurement, false where it is an upper limit.

limit_sigma.description: Significance of the upper limit [sigma], where is_detection is false. Circulars most often quote 3.

extinction_corrected.description: True where Galactic extinction has already been removed from value.

calibration_reference.description: Catalogue the measurement was calibrated against (e.g., PS1, SDSS, APASS, 2MASS, Gaia).

unit.description: Magnitude system (zeropoint convention) for value. Photometry's mag_system names the same thing for a single measurement.
